history.summary: A keyword-stuffed Clementi D05 listing ('CHEAP NEW 1km NAN HUA') with contradictory bed labels (4BR bracket vs '3-bedroom' title), no MRT info, no built_year and no URA data, priced at $2.679M / $2221 PSF. The '⭐️CHEAP⭐️' framing is marketing, not substance — $2221 PSF for a 99yr D05 unit is not cheap, and the project identity is unverifiable.
history.rating_rationale: Despite the 'CHEAP' hook, $2221 PSF is full mid-market price for a D05 99yr unit, and at $2.679M / 4BR+ band the exit pool is shallow. Bed-count label conflicts with the title, MRT distance is blank, built_year is missing and there is no URA data — too many gaps to call this a buy. Score 453/1000 is below market. Nan Hua school zone is an own-stay driver, not investment appreciation.
red_flags: No MRT info, no built_year, no URA data
$2221 PSF is not 'cheap' for a 99yr D05 unit; $2.679M is a niche exit
catalysts: 1km to Nan Hua Primary (family own-stay demand)
D05 One-North/Science Park employment supports tenancy
